result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The fix is one condition in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, plus a Javadoc sentence saying so. The rest of the query is unchanged, so reps with no purchase orders still show 0 and the ordering is the same.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (3 tests, 0 failures). I did not add a test for the cancelled case, and I did not commit.

The per-country purchase order count just below it (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry`) has the same gap: it also counts cancelled orders. I left it alone because the task only covered the per-rep report. It is a one-line change if you want it fixed too.
